I am a computational physicist and materials scientist. I am also broadly interested in plasma physics, climate science, applied math, and machine learning.

I have been an Assistant Professor in Physics at Boston College since August 2025. Previously, I was a Stanford Science Fellow, working with Prof. Thomas P. Devereaux. I obtained my Ph.D. in physics at Harvard with Prof. Efthimios Kaxiras.

Contact: ziyanzhu@stanford.edu / ziyan.zhu@bc.edu.
